event.proposal: Family: scalar pruning. Current retained frontier is 2,119 parameters at 99.190000%, a +0.190000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 20 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0057 at 2,119 parameters and 99.19%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0058, where the second block-1 ln1 scale neutralization scored 97.60%. The next cross-site scale by neutral deviation is blocks.1.ln2 coordinate 12 at 1.113884449, a deviation of 0.113884449. Hypothesis: the failed coordinate was site-specific and fixing this pre-feed-forward scale to one, alongside the one accepted fixed scale and eight accepted bias zeros, preserves qualification at 2,118 parameters. This is more informative than another same-site ln1 scale because it tests the normalization-site distinction that also mattered for bias pruning.
